title: Wojciech Coach · Apple-native running coach
description: Private running and activity coach for iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac. HealthKit as the single source of truth, live workouts on Watch, adaptive training plan, GPS maps, badges and analysis. Built with SwiftUI and Codex.
problem: Existing fitness apps either require subscriptions, send health data to remote servers, or fragment the experience across devices without a single coherent plan.
system: Apple-native stack: HealthKit reads all workouts and health signals, Apple Watch runs live sessions via HKWorkoutSession, iPhone synthesises the data into a daily decision and adaptive weekly plan, Mac provides the full analysis dashboard. All data stays on device.
artifact: Functional MVP: iOS app, watchOS workout app, macOS analysis centre, WidgetKit extension with Live Activities, and a landing page at coach.wojciech.io.
outcome: Private beta. Start training on Watch, get a plan that reacts to real history, HRV, sleep and weekly load, not a generic programme.
